questions.cardText:
[Zoology] Which bird is known to have the longest migration route?
A. Arctic tern
B. Albatross
C. Canadian goose
Answer: A. The Arctic tern has the longest migration route of any bird, traveling from the Arctic to the Antarctic and back each year. For their lifetime, it is equivalent to three round trips to the moon.
questions.de: Welcher Vogel hat die längste Zugroute, fliegt jedes Jahr von der Arktis in die Antarktis und zurück — im Laufe seines Lebens so weit wie dreimal zum Mond und zurück?
questions.en: Which bird has the longest migration route, flying from the Arctic to the Antarctic and back each year — over a lifetime the equivalent of three round trips to the Moon?

timeline.labelEn: Geolocator tracking of Arctic terns reveals the longest animal migration known
timeline.labelDe: Die Verfolgung von Küstenseeschwalben mit Geolokatoren belegt die längste bekannte Tierwanderung

questions.notes: Wikipedia: about 2.4 million km in a lifetime, more than three Earth–Moon round trips. 'Canadian goose' on the card should read Canada goose.

questions.cardText:
[Astronomy] What is the largest moon in our solar system?
A. Ganymede of Jupiter
B. Titan of Saturn
C. Callisto of Jupiter
Answer: A. Ganymede, a moon of Jupiter, is the largest moon in our solar system, even larger than the planet Mercury.
questions.de: Welcher ist der größte Mond unseres Sonnensystems, sogar größer als der Planet Merkur?
questions.en: What is the largest moon in our Solar System, even larger than the planet Mercury?

timeline.labelEn: Galileo Galilei discovers Jupiter's moon Ganymede
timeline.labelDe: Galileo Galilei entdeckt den Jupitermond Ganymed

questions.notes: Larger than Mercury in diameter, though only about half its mass.
